verdicts.proof: Old: branches_widgets.dart:64 onPressed: onBook ?? context.go(Routes.search), used by branches_info_screen.dart:55. The only v2 entry point is the MgCta in branches_view_v2.dart:76 (onTap: onBook), and onBook is branches_info_screen.dart:34-37: v2SetTabOrigin (it only sets the origin chip state, shell_nav_map.dart:68) and then context.go(Routes.search). It is the same target with no filter, and all catalogue checks apply there.

Old: tile tap and button both run context.push('/pobocky/$i') (branches_info_screen.dart:84-86,102). The route parses with int.tryParse ?? 0 (router.dart:454-456), and BranchDetailScreen clamps it (branch_detail_screen.dart:31) BEFORE the MgV2.on branch at :44. There are two v2 entry points, the card MgPress (branches_view_v2.dart:111) and MgBtnInk (:147). Both call onOpen, which is branches_info_screen.dart:33 with the same push. The v2 list loops over the same branchesInfoMapQueries.length (:64). Profile v2 reaches the list via profile_tiles_v2.dart:48 (Routes.branchesInfo), the same route as the old profile_screen.dart:357.

branchesBack (branches_widgets.dart:13) is shared and is passed as onBack (branches_info_screen.dart:31) to MgAppBar (branches_view_v2.dart:50). The same ref.refresh(branchesInfoProvider) is passed as onRefresh (:32), and MgPage wraps it in a RefreshIndicator (mg_page.dart:182-186). MgPage adds no PopScope, so the system back works as before.

The v2 MgBtnGhostLight (branches_view_v2.dart:83) calls onMotosSheet = showBranchesSheet(context) (branches_info_screen.dart:38). Inside showBranchesSheet, the shared fetch with its active/is_open filter (branches_sheet.dart:25-30) runs before the MgV2.on branch (:58-65).
